hypothesis: H-FLUSH-MW: buying meme-perp flushes only when they are market-wide (many coins flushing together) is profitable after costs
origin: Inferred, untested lead from reports/failures/agent_flush.md: the busiest market-wide flush days in TRAIN were net positive while idiosyncratic flushes lost. Because it came from exploring train, train results are optimistic; validation is the real test.
universe: same 21 train coins / 22 validation coins as agent_flush (flush_fetch.UNIVERSE, PUMPUSDT only after 2025-07-10)
coin_flush: per coin, at OI snapshot time s (metrics stamp + 5 min): z_OI <= -2.5 and z_P <= -2.5 with 30-day trailing sd strictly before s (identical to flush_sim.signals)
market_wide_rule: a flush of coin c at snapshot time s is ELIGIBLE iff the number of distinct universe coins (including c) with a coin_flush at a snapshot time in (s - 30 min, s] is >= K. Only snapshots <= s are counted, all of which are visible at decision time s + 1 min (point in time). Coins that flushed earlier in the window before the count reached K are NOT entered retroactively.
entry: T0 = s + 1 min; 'lim0.3%': resting bid at open(T0) * (1 - 0.003) for 5 one-minute bars, fills only if a bar low is strictly below; 'mkt': taker buy at open(T0) + 3 bp slippage
exit: taker after H minutes from the fill bar, -3% stop checked from the fill bar (conservative), 3 bp slippage
costs: HL tier 0 maker 1.5 bp / taker 4.5 bp, 5 bp venue-mismatch haircut per round trip, HL hourly funding (Binance settlements for DOGE/1000PEPE)
position_rule: one position per coin; signals while a position or order is live are skipped
bar: n >= 50, net sum > 0, PF > 1.2, net with the 3 best trades removed > 0
validation_protocol: only configs passing the full bar on train are scored, once, on validation with the identical rule; no changes after seeing train
